field.name: tournament_id
field.label: COM_XDECAROCOMPETITIONS_FIELD_TOURNAMENT
field.query: SELECT id AS value, name AS text FROM #__xdecarocompetitions_tournaments WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY ordering ASC, name ASC

field.name: host_country_code
field.label: COM_XDECAROCOMPETITIONS_FIELD_HOST_COUNTRY
field.query: SELECT code AS value, name AS text FROM #__xdecarocompetitions_countries WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY ordering ASC, name ASC

field.name: organizer_ids
field.label: COM_XDECAROCOMPETITIONS_FIELD_ORGANIZER
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, IF(short_name IS NULL OR short_name = '', '', CONCAT(' (', short_name, ')'))) AS text FROM #__xdecarocompetitions_organizations WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY ordering ASC, name ASC
